title: Fix rejected drain PR #162 (agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-77)
description:
Drain PR #162 (branch `agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-77`) was NOT merged by pr-auto-review (llm-rejected).
Repair it ON THE EXISTING BRANCH — do NOT create a new branch or a second PR:
1. `git fetch origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-77 && git checkout agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-77`
2. Address EVERY reason below.
3. Run `npm test` until green.
4. Commit and `git push origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-77` — the reviewer re-reviews at the new SHA.

## Rejection reasons (verbatim)
- [major] Missing imports: Line 195-196 uses 'join', 'mkdirSync', 'readFileSync', 'writeFileSync', 'existsSync' without importing them — Add required imports from 'fs' and 'path'
- [major] Template file existence not validated: Line 225 reads template files without checking if they exist — Add file existence checks with proper error handling for missing templates
- [minor] Hardcoded author name: Line 229 uses 'hermes-drain' as author — Make author configurable or use a more generic identifier
- [minor] Incomplete template substitution: Line 287-288 leaves empty stream fields instead of omitting them — Consider cleaning up empty template placeholders for better output quality
